title: Modular Nahm sums for symmetrizable matrices of indices $({2,\ldots, 2},1)$ and $({1,\ldots, 1},2)$
summary: In this paper, we present three families of modular Nahm sums for symmetrizable matrices with arbitrary rank $r\geq 2$ of indices $({2,\ldots, 2},1)$ and $({1,\ldots, 1},2)$. Specifically, the cases corresponding to $r = 2$ and $r = 3$ of these families have been previously demonstrated by Mizuno, Warnaar, and B. Wang-L. Wang. Building upon these three families, we construct two vector-valued automorphic forms, one of which is a vector-valued modular function when $r$ is odd.
